# Zaroorat

> Zaroorat (ضرورت, Urdu for "need") is a crowdfunding and donation platform for Pakistan, based in Lahore. People donate to verified medical, education and emergency fundraisers, give Zakat, or start a free fundraiser. Every campaign is reviewed before it goes live and every donation is verified by hand against a payment receipt.

Website: https://zaroorat.xyz
Contact: contactzaroorat@gmail.com · +92 321 4012041 · 48 FF, Phase 4, DHA, Lahore, Pakistan

## How Zaroorat works

- Field volunteers visit families in need across Pakistan, check documents (hospital papers, bills, fee slips) and write up their story. These campaigns are marked "Verified" and use a representative photo to protect the family's privacy.
- Anyone in Pakistan can also start a fundraiser for free; the Zaroorat team reviews and approves it before it goes live.
- Donors pay by direct bank transfer into one verified Zaroorat bank account and upload a screenshot of the transfer. There is no card or payment gateway.
- The team matches each payment to its receipt before counting it, emails the donor a confirmation, and pays the funds out to the campaign.
- Campaigns can be paused or removed if concerns are reported.
